metadata.value: This repository contains code and data to use [CaLiGraph](http://caligraph.org) as a benchmark dataset in the [Semantic Reasoning Evaluation Challange](https://semrec.github.io) at the [International Semantic Web Conference 2021 (ISWC'21)](https://iswc2021.semanticweb.org). The paper describing the dataset characteristics and results for well-known reasoners can be found [here](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2110.05028.pdf).
